research.edition: international EODHD REST API at eodhd.com/api
research.searchCoverage: Official EODHD REST API is GET https://eodhd.com/api/{path} with api_token query authentication. GET /user is the documented account probe used by the pinned credential validator and is used as healthcheck rather than instrument search. GET /exchanges-list, GET /real-time/{ticker}, and GET /eod/{ticker} are documented reads. Quote and EOD default to CSV, so native always sends fmt=json. Operator is Unicorn Data Services SAS in Lyon, France. HTTP 200 bodies may carry message or error; native bodyErrorPaths demote those to failures. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying EODHD platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

HTTP 200 bodies with message or error are treated as failures via bodyErrorPaths, matching pinned source.
Native category is banking-data rather than Finance/Data: Rust CATEGORIES has no finance or data bucket.
Returns raw EODHD JSON under data rather than the upstream {user} wrapper. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
